info.title: BLACK X Business API
info.description: Database-agnostic business API for BLACK X Construction & Finishing. Foundation wave 1: customers are fully writable; other domains are read-only over repository ports with writes returning 501 until their gating owner decisions land (see x-blocked-by). No production database adapter is integrated yet: without one, business endpoints fail closed with 503 instead of inventing persistence. Normative prose contract: docs/api-contract-v1.md. Colleague integration: docs/database-integration-contract.md.
